items.title: Clean tanker spot earnings slip 4.8% on the week
items.summary: Makai's week 47 report puts clean spot earnings down 4.8% w/w and 13.4% below the late-October peak. MRs led the decline as Atlantic MR earnings fell sharply while Pacific MRs held; LRs eased 2.1% and are 10–15% off peak, Handies rose on a Med/Med rebound, and the LR2 premium over Aframaxes widened past $100k/day.

items.title: MEG MR freight falls w125 as Hormuz transits slow
items.summary: Platts assessed the Middle East MR benchmark down w125 on Nov 18. Vitol placed Torm Stellar at w500 for Nov 25 diesel Duqm–East Africa and Weco Amalie went at w475 Sikka–East Africa. S&P Global counted 14 daily Hormuz transits on Nov 9 versus 32 at end-October; in Asia, Oriental Sunstone was placed at $975,000 South Korea–Japan, the first sub-$1m on that run since late August.
items.source: Hellenic Shipping News / S&P Global Platts

items.title: CENTCOM extends Iran blockade to ship-to-ship receivers
items.summary: A CENTCOM advisory issued Nov 18 says vessels taking cargo at sea from ships that loaded in Iran may be treated as blockade runners and can be stopped, boarded or diverted. The blockade was first imposed Apr 13, lifted in June and reimposed Jul 14; Iranian crude exports have been close to zero for months, with some LPG and jet fuel moving since July.

items.title: Suezmaxes and Aframaxes carry 2m b/d through Hormuz
items.summary: Vortexa data show Suezmaxes and Aframaxes moved more than 2 million b/d through Hormuz in October, the highest since the conflict began, as total Gulf exports reached 11.4 million b/d. BRS says VLCCs still made 72% of transits; Gulf–China Suezmax rates are running at roughly one-third to just under half the VLCC benchmark.

items.title: Crude tanker rates retreat as Saudi East-West line restarts
items.summary: Breakwave reports crude freight well below October highs. The Saudi East-West pipeline has resumed, more VLCCs are ballasting east, and VLCCs are again competitive with Suezmaxes out of West Africa; the IEA projects Q4 supply above demand.

items.title: Abandoned LPG tanker Tara Gas still burning off Oman
items.summary: The Panama-flagged Tara Gas, hit near Khasab on Nov 16 and again on Nov 17, was abandoned; Oman rescued 24 of 25 crew and one Indian seafarer is missing. A NAVAREA IX warning at 1500 UTC Nov 18 placed the burning ship about 5.7 nm off Khawr Ghub Ali, drifting southeast.

items.title: ADNOC L&S tanker attacked; 11 injured, one missing
items.summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services reported an attack on one of its vessels on the evening of Nov 17 that injured 11 crew, with one missing. Vanguard Tech identified the ship as the product tanker Navig8 Messi; ADNOC has not named it, so the identity is unconfirmed. UKMTO logged three attacks in the Gulf and off Oman in two days.

items.title: US LNG cargoes turn from Egypt toward Europe
items.summary: Kpler and Bloomberg tracking show at least two US LNG carriers left Egypt-bound routes and two more laden with US cargo turned north to Europe since last week, including Al Qassar and Amaryllis Knutsen (U-turn near Egypt). Greenergy Wind turned south toward the Cape, heading for Asia.

items.title: Coast Guard sets New Orleans safety zone through Dec 11
items.summary: A temporary zone covers Lower Mississippi miles 95.5–96.5, 500 ft off the east bank near the Crescent City Connection, for salvage of the capsized riverboat American Heritage after the Nov 13 allision by tanker Atlantic Asphalt. The river is not closed: limited two-way traffic uses the main span, with deep-draft ships and tows of 10+ barges one-way. NTSB preliminary data cite a steering casualty; cause undetermined.

items.title: LA/Long Beach security workers could strike from Nov 21
items.summary: About 250 ILWU Local 26 members, who staff six terminals handling roughly 85% of Long Beach and 33% of LA cargo per PMA, may walk out at 12:01 a.m. Saturday when their extension expires. Talks resume Friday; the coastwide dockworker contract runs to 2028.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen at APEC
items.summary: Trump held separate bilaterals with Xi (about an hour; their third meeting this year) and Putin on Nov 19 before a three-way session. Reuters reports the leaders agreed a 'peace declaration' reaffirming that nuclear war must never be fought, according to China and Russia; no outcomes on Ukraine, Iran or trade had been confirmed at time of writing. The US–China trade truce expires Jan 10.

items.title: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8bn, guides $130bn for Q4
items.summary: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8bn (+103% y/y), EPS $2.68 and net income $65.3bn, all ahead of estimates, with data-center sales of $107.6bn. It guided Q4 to $130bn ±3% and raised its FY28 growth outlook to 75%. The board said former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned Nov 12, will not return; Colette Kress is interim CEO.

items.title: Brent near $92 as tanker attacks offset supply outlook
items.summary: Brent traded around $92.01/bbl and WTI $83.00 early Nov 19. Vortexa says Iran has designated more than half of the tankers Gulf states use for STS transfers to the Gulf of Oman, without a drop in volumes so far; ING expects supply to ease on OPEC+, Russian exports and US stocks. The Fed has signaled a possible hike at its December meeting.

items.title: COP31 draft keeps fossil-fuel wording open ahead of Friday deadline
items.summary: The 18-page draft text in Antalya offers both the 2023 'transitioning away' language and a stronger 'phase out', and either could be dropped. Disputes remain over Turkey's proposal to raise electricity to 35% of global energy by 2035 and over adaptation finance; the official deadline is Friday, Nov 20.

items.title: Texans (3–6) host Colts tonight, 7:15 PM CT
items.summary: Houston plays Indianapolis at home on Thursday Night Football on Nov 19, kickoff 7:15 PM CT. Result will appear in the next update.

items.title: Broncos (7–2) host Raiders (4–6) Sunday, 3:25 PM CT
items.summary: Denver hosts Las Vegas on Sunday, Nov 22, at 3:25 PM CT on CBS, favored by 10 (total 40.5). Bo Nix has 1,730 passing yards, 11 TD and 4 INT; for the Raiders, Brock Bowers (ankle) is expected to play without needing practice.

items.title: ATP Finals: Alcaraz into semis; Tiafoe beats Cobolli
items.summary: On Nov 18 in Turin, Alcaraz defeated Medvedev 6-2 6-4 to clinch a semifinal place from the Lendl Group, and Tiafoe earned his first Finals win, 7-6(6) 6-0 over Cobolli. In doubles, Krawietz/Puetz also qualified for the semifinals.

items.title: ATP Finals: last round-robin matches Thu–Fri
items.summary: Thursday's singles schedule in Turin is Shelton vs Jodar and Zverev vs Fils; Friday has Alcaraz vs Cobolli and Medvedev vs Tiafoe. The event runs through Sunday, Nov 22.
